subject: Draft marketplace term sheet: metered SKU entitlement mapping & invoice routing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Draft marketplace term sheet: metered SKU entitlement mapping & invoice routing

Hi Laura / CloudNova team,

Following our call earlier, attaching a focused term sheet that maps the proposed metered SKU IDs to entitlement IDs and outlines invoice routing options for the private offer. High level asks:

- Confirm whether your procurement team requires PO line-level references for each metered SKU (we can include PO Line IDs in the marketplace invoice metadata).
- Confirm preferred invoicing path: (A) Marketplace vendor invoice (AWS invoice with passthrough to Redwood) or (B) Direct Redwood invoice with marketplace listing as reference. Each has different tax and revenue recognition implications; we've outlined the differences on p2.
- Reseller uplift: we proposed a 5% reseller uplift to be passed back to CloudNova as a channel rebate. If you need a structured waterfall (different % by SKU family), list the buckets and target uplifts.

Notes:
- AWS Marketplace action item: please confirm the metering plan id(s) we should reference and whether the marketplace will surface the Vendor Proof-of-Origin (VPO) header in invoicing metadata. That token is required for automated entitlement reconciliation on our side.
- We included an example PO-line spreadsheet to show how CloudNova could format the PO; it is only an example.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-marketplace-termsheet-v1.pdf (PDF)]

Next steps: if you can confirm PO line requirements and preferred invoicing path by EOD Wednesday, we can generate a DocuSign-ready term sheet for signature and request the marketplace to issue the private offer.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

-----Original Message-----

From: Laura Chen <procurement@cloudnova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace term sheet: metered SKU entitlement mapping & invoice routing

Jordan,

Thanks — reviewed quickly with procurement and finance. A few clarifications from our side before we finalize:

1) PO line-level detail: Yes, we require PO Line IDs for each SKU when the invoicing is driven by marketplace usage. We typically provide a single PO with multiple PO lines (one line per SKU family). Including the marketplace metering plan id on each PO line would be ideal.

2) Invoicing path: Our preference is Marketplace vendor invoice (option A) because: (a) it maps natively to our ERP routing for marketplace purchases, (b) it reduces delays in our AP process. We understand Redwood's revenue recognition concerns — happy to accept a short window for vendor reconciliation if needed.

3) Reseller uplift: CloudNova requests a 7% channel rebate on net usage for the first 12 months as part of our initial adoption commitment. We can re-evaluate at renewal.

I've attached an internal template for PO lines — will complete and return once we align on the SKU to PO-line mapping. Can AWS confirm whether the VPO header and metering-plan id will be included in monthly metered invoices?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager | CloudNova
procurement@cloudnova.com
[Attachment: cloudnova_po_template_example.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace term sheet: metered SKU entitlement mapping & invoice routing

Jordan / team,

Quick internal alignment on CloudNova's asks:

- Channel rebate: CloudNova asked for 7% for 12 months. From a channel economics POV, we can accept a higher initial uplift but recommend structuring it as a two-tier waterfall: 7% on core compute SKUs, 4% on add-on SKUs (embedding/feature flags). This protects unit economics while meeting the customer's request.

- Marketplace invoice metadata: if CloudNova prefers Option A (Marketplace vendor invoice), we need AWS to guarantee the inclusion of: metering_plan_id, usage_start/usage_end, PO Line ID, and VPO token in the invoice payload. Without VPO, reconciliation will be manual and cause delays for recognizing revenue to the correct order.

- Revenue ops / finance ask (Naomi): If we accept marketplace vendor invoicing with the 7% rebate, finance will need a clear mapping so we can net the rebate on our side for revenue recognition (invoice-level memos are not enough). Suggest we: (a) capture PO Line ID in our billing ingestion pipeline, (b) route the rebate as a contra-revenue line item with an internal memo referencing deal CNV-4821.

I've attached a short proforma showing the waterfall example and impact on net ARR for year 1.

Attachments: [Attachment: reseller-uplift-proforma.xlsx]

Ben
Director, Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Laura / team — looping finance in to confirm operational asks and next steps.

Thanks for the direction on invoice path — Marketplace vendor invoice (Option A) is acceptable to Redwood provided we get the metadata items Ben listed and a signed term sheet that outlines the rebate waterfall and effective dates.

Operational checklist we need from CloudNova before DocuSign:
- Completed PO with PO Line IDs for each SKU family (use the attached example file).
- Confirmation of channel rebate structure (CloudNova has asked for 7% for 12 months; Redwood proposes two-tier: 7% core / 4% addons). If you accept the two-tier, we will reflect that in the term sheet.
- Confirmation that CloudNova's AP team will accept an AWS Marketplace vendor invoice as primary; if so, please provide the ERP vendor code we should include in the marketplace private offer.

Once we have the completed PO and a short confirmation of the rebate waterfall, Jordan will issue an updated term sheet and Naomi will request finance to pre-authorize the contra-revenue path. We'll also open a ticket with AWS Marketplace to confirm VPO availability and metering_plan_id exposure in the monthly invoice file.

DocuSign: Jordan — can you prepare the DocuSign link as soon as CloudNova confirms the PO format?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
